product.amstrad-pc9486i.summary: The PCI 486 that Amstrad introduced alongside the Pentium PC9555i.
product.amstrad-pc9486i.history: Amstrad introduced the PC9486i at CeBIT 1995 as its 486 option alongside the Pentium PC9555i. On 7 April, Computerwoche reported that Amstrad was already offering a 66 MHz 486DX2 and a 100 MHz 486 variant.
product.amstrad-pc9486i.technical.cpu: PCI provided a way to add expansion cards. Amstrad support distinguishes the AT/PCI PC9486i from the AT PC9486 and lists SVGA graphics.
product.amstrad-pc9486i.technical.storag: Two Enhanced IDE interfaces connected storage devices. Computerwoche describes the same arrangement for the PC9555i.
product.amstrad-pc9486i.warning: Original BIOS and BluMach boot validation pending.
product.amstrad-pc9486i.technical.firmwa: Amstrad support mentioned a PC9486i manual in September 1997. The manual and original firmware remain to be recovered.
product.amstrad-pc9486i.technical.verifi: Contemporary press and Amstrad support establish the commercial identity and bus. The BluMach status is research.
product.amstrad-pc9486i.technical.limita: Motherboard and SVGA controller identification, an attributable BIOS and boot validation are pending.
